integrity: Proof contains an explicit nonzero terminal Cartier chain, plus an independent cited upper bound. The executable performs finite exact-arithmetic checks, not infinite certification; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The assertion gives the exact nilpotency index only, not every higher Cartier rank. It is restricted to odd n>=3, q=p^t, and the stated Serre-type monomial equation. The known maximality and the general upper bound are used as prior theorems; historical priority is not independently guaranteed.
title: Sharp Cartier nilpotency for the Serre-type maximal curves
